about.title: About
about.p1: AI/ML Engineer with hands-on experience building <cyan>production-grade LLM applications</cyan> and CI/CD-integrated ML pipelines. Skilled in prompt engineering, security hardening for AI agents, and MLOps.
about.p2: M.Sc. in Computer Science at UFPel. Currently building local-first AI agents and researching multimodal vision-language models.

contact.title: Contact
contact.text: Want to collaborate, discuss AI, or just say hello?

projectDesc.openjarvis: Local-first personal AI agent framework. On-device agents with security guardrails, capability-based RBAC, and PII redaction. Stanford-affiliated open source.
projectDesc.multimodal: M.Sc. thesis: detects 7 programming behaviors from screen recordings using Vision-Language Models (Qwen2.5-VL). Evaluation with Cohen's kappa and F1.
projectDesc.hypsim: 16-bit CPU simulator with 3-pass assembler, macro processor, multi-file linker, and loader. Rust rewrite of SSCH. 68 tests.
